signatures.object: 单任务 worker harness H（提示、工具、编排、观测结构、模型配置——除模型参数外的全部代码与配置）
signatures.information: worker 执行轨迹；Evaluator 报告（含环境真值状态核验、逐条成功标准、LLM/工具耗时拆分）与分数；完整历史（每轮 harness、报告、分数、verdict）。
signatures.operation: Evolution Agent 读历史与当前最优 harness，识别失败模式并修改 harness；循环 K 步。
signatures.output: 新 harness H(k)；最终返回 H(best)、best_score、history。
signatures.conditions: 每步在干净环境重置后重跑任务；两级评分（通过/失败，再按时间）。
signatures.feedback: Evaluator 的诊断报告与分数。
signatures.selection_rule_data: score > best_score 记 improved 并更新最优，否则 regressed；下一步从 H(best) 出发演化。数据=同一任务上的单次执行（无独立验证）。
signatures.persistence: history 与 H(best)（含版本控制操作被列为 Λ 的工具）；回退=回到最优。
signatures.later_use: 下一步 worker 重建自 H(k-1)；最终最优 harness 用于该任务。
signatures.claimed_effect: 无结果；声称自动化 harness 工程。
signatures.failure_boundary: 单次执行比较含随机性；无复核；评估器与演化器同属蓝图。

signatures.object: 演化蓝图 Λ=(W_H, H(0), V, E)：评估器提示、演化器提示、观测结构、评分函数、循环超参（迭代数、回退阈值、停止准则）
signatures.information: 跨训练任务的各内循环历史与得分 meta_history；元进化智能体 E_meta。
signatures.operation: 每轮对所有训练任务运行内循环，取 best_score 均值为 meta_score；E_meta 在最优 Λ 基础上改写 Λ。
signatures.conditions: 式(2)只看最终 best_score；评估器与评分函数同在可改范围内。
signatures.feedback: meta_score（由可被同一元循环修改的评估器产生）。
signatures.selection_rule_data: meta_score > best_meta_score 则 improved；否则 regressed。数据=元训练任务；元测试任务仅计划用于评估。
signatures.later_use: Λ(best) 作为新任务内循环的配置（计划）。
signatures.claimed_effect: 新任务收敛更快、迭代与算力更少（计划，未验证）。
signatures.failure_boundary: 评估器可被元循环修改，目标分数与被改动对象耦合；无不可变锚点；训练目标与计划指标不一致。

domain_pattern.reason: H19 (both): the outer loop edits the improver blueprint by the downstream scores of its products. H12 (son55): the inner loop has an evolution agent read traces and evaluator reports, classify recurring failures and edit harness code (tools, prompts, orchestration), keeping the best. That is the H12 tactic, proposed but not run.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Fixed human-designed blueprint Λ (evaluator/evolver prompts, scoring, observation, loop control) → outer meta-evolution scored by inner-loop best_score.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: H19 needs an immutable anchor. Λ includes the evaluator and the scoring function, so the meta-loop can edit its own objective (S1 unmet, F5 unmet).

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Inner loop: worker executes → evaluator diagnoses against ground-truth environment state → evolution agent patches harness code from full history → best retained.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: Design only; the strict-improvement best rule is the only retention gate.

G.reason: Opus sides with son55. The motivation (manual harness engineering, with two practitioner reports) is real. Nearest-neighbour positioning is a single APO citation (LLM-AutoDiff), and automated harness or agent-design search and self-modifying agents are never discussed. No residual bottleneck of existing automated methods is identified. Between anchor 0 (no nearest neighbour) and 2 (real limitation, incomplete comparison).

M.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. The inner loop (separated evaluator and evolver, full history, best retention) is a concrete response to manual harness engineering. Key logic is weak: the meta-objective is final best_score but the claim is faster adaptation (son55:E006, E007), and the meta-loop may edit the evaluator and scoring that produce its own objective, with no immutable anchor.
